title: Chapter 25: Hope From Eating Meat
content:
Chapter 25: Hope From Eating Meat

As the sky gradually darkened, the residents of the territory in the wild began to return to the city under the protection of the Zerg.

No one had an accident that day, and all potential dangers were eliminated by the Zerg in advance.

In broad daylight, nothing could do anything in front of the host.

Everyone returned to the city safely and immediately smelled the rich aroma of meat.

This is the lord's promise!

Some women who did not leave the city had already placed large pots collected from the lord's castle and various places on the street, and large pieces of various animal meat were being cooked in the pots.

It was gurgling and steaming.

The aroma of meat filled the entire town.

Seeing this, everyone's eyes began to glow green, and they wanted to rush up to grab a piece!

But no one dared to move, because every few distances, there was a puppy standing guard quietly.

Everyone had seen the horror of puppies.

Everyone followed the arrangements, honestly finished the work in hand first, and then went for a simple wash before going to the street where the meat was cooked to wait for the meat.

Men, women, old and young in the city came out. Everyone has meat to eat, not just a slogan. Today, no matter who you are, you can get a piece of meat.

Everyone followed the host's command, lined up, and came forward one by one to receive it.

A piece of steaming, fragrant meat was in their hands, and many people were still a little bit unbelievable.

"Everyone eat! Don't save the meat today!"

Hu Tu shouted on the side, picked up a piece himself, and took the lead to eat it in big mouthfuls.

With Hu Tu taking the lead, everyone took the meat they got and swallowed it in big mouthfuls in the afterglow of the setting sun.

They didn't have to save it for their families. Everyone in the whole territory had a share today and ate meat.

Everyone was very satisfied with this meal of meat!

This meal of meat made everyone see the hope of future life!

This meal of meat made everyone recognize the new lord from the bottom of their hearts!

"Follow such a lord, there is meat to eat!"

Everyone had some different feelings for Wu Qing, the lord.

…

The feast always has to end. After eating and drinking, everyone who participated in the work received the settlement amount of grain sent to them by the Queen of Zerg, and they can go to the grain warehouse to collect it tomorrow morning.

The grain collected today can only be hastily stored in the warehouse, and it needs to be sorted, sorted and processed. Now it is late, the lighting in the city is poor, and we can't work at night, so we can only wait until tomorrow.

A very simple big pot meal gave people hope.

But big pot meals cannot be eaten often, and everyone still needs to rely on their own efforts to change their lives.

After cleaning up the scene, everyone went home with excitement.

At night, the Zerg army began to move out again, routinely plucking a handful of weird wool. Now it is the third night, and everyone has gotten used to it.

Wu Qing also spent a peaceful day in the Zerg territory.

After a day of development in the Zerg territory, the Hydralisks have been hatched, and the number of Hydralisks has reached 420, which has doubled.

The number of puppies stopped hatching when it reached 1,000, and the number of worker bees also increased to 300, which can provide a certain amount of energy stably every day.

The number of hosts is closely following the population limit and is controlled by the Queen.

Next, if there is no war, the daily energy will be used to strengthen the territory defense and continue to produce puppies.

Without strange harassment, Wu Qing can sleep well again.

...

The next morning, the city of Daxia Territory became lively, and the Queen had assigned them work.

Most people have to stay in the city today to deal with the grain harvested yesterday. Many things need to be sorted and stored, and then processed, otherwise it is not easy to store.

Only a few people were arranged to follow the Zerg to continue to obtain food from the wild to reassure the people.

Everyone went to the grain warehouse to collect the unprocessed food as a reward, and after breakfast, everyone started another day's work.

Just at breakfast time, a thin human man in his forties found Hu Tu and asked to change his job. He wanted to follow the Zerg troops to the wild.

His reason was that he needed to go to the wild to collect herbs.

Hu Tu knew him, and he was an acquaintance.

This person is Wang He, the only doctor in the city. He is usually responsible for treating the residents in the city. His current job should be to sit in the clinic.

Now as the only doctor in the city, he should respond to Wu Qing's call for talents, but he did not, and has been unknown.

The work was arranged by the Queen of Insects. Hu Tu could not make the decision, so he had to tell the Queen of Insects about the situation, and Wu Qing knew about it.

Wu Qing has never had time to understand the specific situation of various races in the city. He feels that there are too many races in Daxia Territory now. There are only so many people in total, and there are no less than 30 races he has seen with his own eyes.

He knows that there are human races in the city, but he really doesn't know what the specific situation is.

Through the host's vision, he saw this human doctor named Wang He, who was thin and straight, and his height was estimated to be over 1.8 meters, but he looked a little thin among the alien races.

This world has energy similar to Yuanqi. Living in such an environment, people here look good even if they don't have enough to eat every day.

Wang He looks to be in his forties, with typical Oriental features, and he looks quite handsome.

In modern times, he would be a standard handsome uncle, a type that girls like very much.

"No wonder these aliens don't find me strange at all, the human race in this world looks very much like an Oriental race."

Wu Qing met aliens, and he had some guesses when he saw their reactions to him.

Now, his guesses have been confirmed.

"Hu Tu, give him an ID card and ask him to bind it. I have something to say to him."

Wu Qing said to Hu Tu through the ID card.

The extra ID cards were given to Hu Tu for safekeeping, and Hu Tu also bound one himself to facilitate contact and communication.

"Yes! Big Brother!"

Hu Tu responded and took an ID card. Although he called him Big Brother, he did not dare to be disrespectful. He just changed the title of "Lord" to "Big Brother" according to Wu Qing's request. His mentality has not changed yet.

Wu Qing did not force this. After all, people in this world are different.

Hu Tu handed the ID card to Wang He and said, "This is the ID card given by the Lord. It has many very magical functions. You drop blood to bind it first. The Lord will talk to you in person!"

Wang He saw the ID card handed to him, hesitated for a moment, and took it.

He knew about this ID card. He heard that everyone who joined the lord through the Talent Recruitment Hall had this ID card.

He had no interest in helping the lord do things, but Wu Qing's actions yesterday changed his mind. In addition, the previous lord took away all the useful things, so he had no medicinal materials to treat his illness. That's why he took the initiative to ask to go to the wild to collect herbs.

Since he had taken this step, it was only a matter of time before the lord noticed him. He might as well be straightforward and accept the lord's indirect recruitment now.
